text.text_excerpt: I just adore this hotel! The entire hotel was pristine and the service was perfect. I found myself at the downstairs bar a every morning and at happy hour enjoying the delicious cocktails and snacks (French 75 comes with french fries at happy hour-- great idea and it made me giggle when I first saw it on the menu). My room was perfect: Clean, quiet, a good use of space, mini fridge and complimentary drinks, shampoo, conditioner and body wash. I did have an issue with how the shower stall was set up. They went a little too modern with the shower door being a half cover of glass -- I really wish they had put sliding glass door instead. Water just went right out of the opening onto the floor...

This hotel has a very fun vibe and trendy feel with a very lively but compact lobby. What made this hotel special to me was my experience with the front desk. They were so warm and welcoming even though I had to wait for a room to open I did not mind. The rooms had updated marble bathrooms and the rooms nicely designed with old wood and polished cement floors. You do not feel like you were in relegated to a standard box. The rooms were relatively small and cozy. There are plenty of outlets. The location is excellent for French Quarter access. However, there were a few drawbacks. Yay! This newly renovated hotel is an Instagrammer's paradise. The decor is v. old worldly in a hipster-y way (and I mean that in the best way possible). The bar is cozy with plenty of seating and the happy hour menu is awesome. I especially love the French 75 served with french fries; the spicy dipping sauce alone is worth the order. Our room, albeit small, was pretty and comfortable. The king-sized bed was plush and every night was restful. We had the smallest window in the corner, which might have offered a view if the CBD wasn't so boring and lacking in pretty architecture.
